scripts.build:playground: tsc docs/playground/playground.ts --outDir docs/playground --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --allowSyntheticDefaultImports
scripts.build:extension: tsc extension/src/*.ts --outDir extension/dist --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --allowSyntheticDefaultImports
scripts.release: pnpm run version && pnpm run sync:version && pnpm run build:extension && cd extension && zip -r ../message-channel-tracker.zip . -x "src/*" "*.ts" && cd ..
scripts.package:extension: pnpm run sync:version && pnpm run build:extension && cd extension && zip -r ../message-channel-tracker.zip . -x "src/*" "*.ts" && cd ..
scripts.prepush: pnpm run type-check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test
scripts.docs:serve: pnpm run build:playground && python3 -m http.server 5174 --directory docs --bind 127.0.0.1
scripts.hero:capture:tip:
echo '1) pnpm run docs && open http://localhost:5174/hero-demo.html
2) 화면 녹화(QuickTime 등)로 6–8초 캡처
3) 파일을 docs/assets/hero-src.mp4 로 저장한 뒤, 아래 명령으로 변환'
